programme.desc: Universet er fullt av eksplosjoner som skaper og ødelegger. Dette er en nedtelling av de ti største og kraftigste eksplosjonene som har rystet kosmos.

programme.title: Warriors
programme.desc: Terry Schappert avslører hvorfor vikingene ble kalt "Middelalderens Hells Angels". Han prøver våpnene og taktikkene de brukte da de herjet i Europa. De plyndret Europa, men møtte sine likemenn, sakserne, i slaget ved Maldon.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Vi ser nærmere på teorien om at et isfritt Antarktis kan ha vært kolonisert av romvesen i fortida, før den global katastrofen istiden.

programme.desc: Vi utforsker gamle skrifter for å avdekke fantastisk teknologi fra Romerriket, blant annet pil og bue trukket av en hest. Var det verdens første stridsvogn?

programme.title: Ancient Top 10
programme.desc: Oldtidens store riker ble skapt gjennom krig, og de største slagene omfattet beleiringer. Fra den legendariske trojanerkrigen til Romerrikets fall. Hvilken beleiring topper lista som den mest ødeleggende?

programme.desc: Når alenemoren Latasha Edwards treffer sin gamle skolevenn Dammon, tror hun at hun har møtt sin sjelevenn. Men bak hans sjarme skjuler det seg en sjalu og voldelig mann.

programme.title: Obsession: Dark Desires
programme.desc: Etter skilsmissen kjøper Cristi et hus som trenger oppussing. Hun håper nevenyttige Curtis kan hjelpe henne, men han blir farlig opphengt i henne.

programme.desc: Liket av en marinesoldat blir funnet i en park på Seychellene, og foreldrene hans tror det skjedde noe uhyggelig med ham den natten han døde.

programme.title: The Real Death In Paradise
programme.desc: I 2005 blir en familieferie i Sharm el-Sheik i Egypt til et mareritt når en rekke bomber går av. Foreldrene forteller om den desperate letingen.

programme.desc: Tomas stopper et par som har med seg store mengder kjøtt. I Skåne oppdages et kremert menneske ved kontroll av en postbil.

programme.desc: Michael Humphreys og Sandra Walton blir skutt og drept, men etterforskerne forstår ikke hvem gjerningspersonene egentlig var ute etter - før de finner opptak av telefonsamtaler.

programme.title: The Devil Speaks
programme.desc: Sharon Garrisons familie melder henne savnet, og mye tyder på at hun har forlatt byen. Et knippe hemmelige kassettbånd peker imidlertid mot noe langt mørkere.

programme.title: Extreme Forensics
programme.desc: En 15 år gammel jente blir brutalt drept på en kirkegård i Ohio. For å fakke drapsmannen må ekspertene gjøre det umulige: finne en DNA-prøve selv om ingen prøve eksisterer.

programme.title: Extreme Forensics
programme.desc: Kimberly McDaniel ble påkjørt av en bil mens hun var ute og jogget, og bilføreren stakk av fra åstedet.

programme.desc: Når to fotballtrenere forsvinner på mystisk vis i 1976, avdekkes rasistiske spenninger i en småby i Oklahoma. Det hele får sjokkerende konsekvenser.

programme.title: The Real Death In Paradise

programme.title: Grensevakten Sverige

programme.title: Min nabo er morder
programme.desc: Kathryn blir brutalt drept i sitt eget hjem, og frykten sprer seg blant naboene. Kan et par fotavtrykk lede politiet til gjerningspersonen?

programme.title: Min nabo er morder
programme.desc: Når Starr Harris blir funnet myrdet i skogen bak hjemmet sitt, skjuler trærne mer enn morderens identitet. Men dyktige politifolk finner snart ubestridelige beviser.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes
programme.desc: En kvinne ringer nødtelefonen for å fortelle at naboen hennes ikke puster og er dekket av blod. Mens politiet leter etter svar, rystes lokalsamfunnet av nok et mord.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes

programme.title: Afrikas naturparker
programme.desc: Ved Augrabies stuper den mektige elven Oranje over den 56 meter høye Augrabies-fossen. Navnet kommer fra ordet «oukurubes», som betyr «et sted med torden» på språket til de innfødte nama-khoi. Dette området er hjertet av en ugjestmild og solfylt verden med innslag av vakre farger og et drønnende brus.

programme.title: Den levende stranden
programme.desc: Florida er berømt for sine vakre sandstrender, og det er mange av dem. Delstaten har den lengste tidevannskysten av alle statene på det kontinentale USA. Disse lekegrindene ved havet er også kritiske habitater for sårbare og utrydningstruede dyrearter.

programme.title: Kalahari: Hemmelige allianser
programme.desc: Møt de uvanlige samarbeidspartnerne som jobber for å sikre at begge overlever i Kalaharibassenget. Lær mer om den symbiotiske forbindelsen mellom en elefantflokk og det fruktbærende treet faidherbia albida, alliansen mellom en surikat og en livlig drongo, samt flere andre umake par i plante- og dyreriket.

programme.title: Kalahari: Hemmelige allianser
programme.desc: Dyrene i Kalahari tørster etter regn i et fryktelig tørt år. Se samarbeidet mellom elefantflokker på desperat leting etter vann, og møt den merkverdige barnevakten til en surikat, som hjelper neste generasjon med å overleve.

programme.title: Det villeste New Zealand
programme.desc: På New Zealand beskytter to villmarksfestninger de sårbare dyrene som er naturlig hjemmehørende her. Den ene er en øde øy som er beskyttet av en vollgrav med saltvann, den andre et tilfluktssted på en bakketopp omgitt av en rovdyrsikker barriere. Dette er historien om disse ømfintlige fristedene og dyrelivet som blomstrer på innsiden.

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australias ville vesten
programme.desc: Opplev den største intakte savannen på planeten, hvor pattedyr og insekter beveger seg gjennom luften med største letthet. Studer tradisjonelle metoder for håndtering av skogbranner, utforsk en sandsteinsgrotte, og se en sukkerglider forsøke å unnslippe flammene.

programme.title: Etter skogbrannene
programme.desc: Vi følger den enorme arbeidet som blir gjort for å gjenopprette skadene buskbrannene som herjet Australia i 2020, gjorde på villmarkslivet.

programme.title: Dyrevern i byen
programme.desc: Redningsteamet må hjelpe en pungrotte som sitter fast i et gjerde, og viser seg å ikke være den typen dyr som spiller død. Inne på sentret får en gås med en alvorlig fotskade fysioterapi før den slippes fri igjen.

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australias ville vesten

programme.title: Min beste venn er et dyr
programme.desc: Vandre på tvers av Amerika med en omreisende kylling, og møt en musefamilie som lever i en hage i England. Bli kvitt araknofobien ved hjelp av en edderkopp, bli med vokteren av verdens to siste stumpneshorn, og gled deg over flere vennskap mellom ulike arter.

programme.title: Min beste venn er et dyr
programme.desc: Lær hvordan kakaduer og nebbdyr ga inspirasjon til nye karrierer, og se hvordan et delt traume gjorde at et menneske og en elefant ble venner for livet. Lek sammen med den 35 år gamle kalkunkondoren George og ta et rørende farvel med kenguruer oppfostret av mennesker.

programme.title: Afrikas naturparker
programme.desc: Mat, vann og ly er livsviktig for alt liv på jorden, fra de minste skapningene til de største. Langs bredden på en av Afrikas største elver trives noen dyr, mens andre sliter. En rytme driver alle dyrene når de leter etter det de trenger for å overleve, og de må alle bestemme seg for hvor og når de skal forflytte seg hvis de skal lykkes. Dette er den magiske verden ved nedre Zambezi.

programme.title: Sultlekene: Alaskas store bjørneutfordring
programme.sub-title: Farvel, og takk for all fisken
programme.desc: Pakk deg godt inn når en kald oktoberstorm gjør det vanskeligere å nå målstreken. Se Big Boi stikke etter et fall før tragedien treffer QuadMom. Hei mens storfavoritten BoldFace finner godformen på tross av ungen, Racoon. Men hvem får bære kronen?

programme.title: Superbeist
programme.desc: Bøy deg i støvet for en av naturens eldste og farligste utholdenhetsrovdyr. Se tigerhaier utnytte kaoset når skilpadder legger egg, overlev oksygenfattige områder med epauletthaier, og motstå det knusende trykket fra dypet med havmusene.

programme.title: Superbeist
programme.desc: Trål havet med alle slags haier, og se hvorfor disse rovfiskene er overlegne under havoverflaten. Finn veien gjennom korallabyrinter med revhaier, ligg på lur for det perfekte angrepet med skjegghaier, og dra på en episk forflytning med hvithaiene.

programme.title: Afrikas naturparker
programme.desc: I hjertet av Zululand i Sør-Afrika ligger Hluhluwe-iMfolozi, det eldste viltreservatet på det afrikanske kontinentet. Her har stumpneshornet funnet beskyttelse for mennesker i tider med omveltning. Neshornene ble jaktet på og nesten utryddet på slutten av 1800-tallet, men da parken kom, ble den redningen for neshornene og avlet dem vekk fra utryddelse.

programme.title: Den levende stranden
programme.desc: I mytologien fra Yucatánhalvøya finner vi den beskyttende morder jord-figuren Ixchel, som bringer fruktbarhet og helbredelse til regionen. I skyggen av Ixchel får vi se et fødselsritual som skjer hvert år på strendene i Mexico: grønne havskilpaddemødre som kravler opp på stranden og graver ned eggene sine.

programme.title: Min beste venn er et dyr

programme.title: Det villeste New Zealand
programme.desc: De isolerte øyene på New Zealand er berømte for å være et uvanlig paradis der det finnes en rekke unike dyr. En nærmere titt viser en annen verden som er mest kjent for fugler som ikke kan fly, eldgamle reptiler og pattedyr som lever langs kysten. Dette er et land fullt av miniatyrmonstre, bittesmå rovdyr og trusler med en bemerkelsesverdig tilværelse, der jegerne også blir jaktet på, og livet er en evig kamp for å overleve. Bli med inn i underskogen og oppdag livet i en ny skala. Fra digre kjøttetende skolopendere og nattaktive gresshopper til edderkopper som fisker, og glødende ormer med feller av silke. Disse ukjente skapningene er både rare og flotte, og de nifseste krypdyrene på det villeste New Zealand.

programme.title: Superbeist
programme.desc: Trål havet med alle slags haier, og se hvorfor disse rovfiskene er overlegne under havoverflaten. Finn veien gjennom korallabyrinter med revhaier, ligg på lur for det perfekte angrepet med skjegghaier, og dra på en episk forflytning med hvithaiene.

programme.title: Afrikas naturparker
programme.desc: I hjertet av Zululand i Sør-Afrika ligger Hluhluwe-iMfolozi, det eldste viltreservatet på det afrikanske kontinentet. Her har stumpneshornet funnet beskyttelse for mennesker i tider med omveltning. Neshornene ble jaktet på og nesten utryddet på slutten av 1800-tallet, men da parken kom, ble den redningen for neshornene og avlet dem vekk fra utryddelse.

programme.title: Den levende stranden
programme.desc: I mytologien fra Yucatánhalvøya finner vi den beskyttende morder jord-figuren Ixchel, som bringer fruktbarhet og helbredelse til regionen. I skyggen av Ixchel får vi se et fødselsritual som skjer hvert år på strendene i Mexico: grønne havskilpaddemødre som kravler opp på stranden og graver ned eggene sine.

programme.title: Det villeste New Zealand
programme.desc: De isolerte øyene på New Zealand er berømte for å være et uvanlig paradis der det finnes en rekke unike dyr. En nærmere titt viser en annen verden som er mest kjent for fugler som ikke kan fly, eldgamle reptiler og pattedyr som lever langs kysten. Dette er et land fullt av miniatyrmonstre, bittesmå rovdyr og trusler med en bemerkelsesverdig tilværelse, der jegerne også blir jaktet på, og livet er en evig kamp for å overleve. Bli med inn i underskogen og oppdag livet i en ny skala. Fra digre kjøttetende skolopendere og nattaktive gresshopper til edderkopper som fisker, og glødende ormer med feller av silke. Disse ukjente skapningene er både rare og flotte, og de nifseste krypdyrene på det villeste New Zealand.

programme.title: Claudio Abbado & Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra - Mozart - Symphony No. 35, K. 385
programme.desc: Claudio Abbado conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Mozart’s “Haffner” Symphony No. 35, K. 385, recorded during the very first Europakonzert in the Smetana Hall in Prague, 1991. Mozart originally composed the symphony as a serenade for the family of Sigmund Haffner, a childhood friend from Salzburg in 1782. The composer made some revisions in the following year, adding multiple instruments and conducted the premiere of the four-movement piece on March 23, 1783, in Vienna. The “Haffner” Symphony, as it is known now, is a transitional work in Mozart’s career. The work was meant to be party music for Salzburg and was transformed into a symphony for Vienna.

programme.title: Pierre Henry is not dead
programme.desc: A pioneer of electronic music, Pierre Henry (1927-2017) has, since the 1950s, alongside Pierre Schaeffer, laid the foundations of what characterizes the music of our time. At the time, everything had to be invented: the sounds, the tools to manipulate them, the ways of broadcasting them. He influenced the pop music of the 1960s and 1970s, from the Beatles to Pink Floyd, and up to the DJs of the 1990s. He is the author of an absolute hit: the electronic jerks composed with Michel Colombier for the 'Messe pour present time' created by Maurice Béjart in 1967. But above all he is the creator of a prolific work, from the end of the 1940s to the 2010s, where pure and incredible sound experiences coexist with musical settings of texts to constitute mock operas of a new genre. Thanks to often unpublished documents, this documentary invites us to listen to Pierre Henry tell us about his journey and above all to listen to his music, one of the most innovative of the 20th century.Subtitles available for this program with your remote control.

programme.desc: Lojalitet och vänskap prövas när otrohet är på menyn. Kocken Shay misstänker att hennes pojkvän sen långt tillbaka, Tony, har mer än mat på menyn i sin foodtruck. Tami och hennes team hjälper Shay att gå till botten med Tonys hemliga sås.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les coachs vocaux et couple marié David et Carrie Grant échangent l'harmonie vocale contre une compétition acharnée d'antiquités. Avec l'aide des experts Will Axon et Mark Stacey, le couple découvre des objets inattendus à vendre lors d’une vente aux enchères dans la campagne du Norfolk.David fait une halte sur un terrain d'herbe en plein cœur de Cambridge, où aujourd'hui les enfants jouent et les chiens se promènent, mais qui était en réalité le berceau du football. Pendant ce temps, Carrie découvre comment Letchworth Garden City a déclenché une révolution dans la conception des villes.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, nous irons à la rencontre de l’artiste Erik Desmazières. Il est l’un des artistes graveurs les plus connus en France, et il est exposé à travers le monde. Il a apporté à cette discipline un peu désuète, une forme de modernité, grâce à ses paysages fantastiques imbibés de science-fiction remarqués tout de suite par les collectionneurs. Membre de l’Académie Française des Beaux-Arts depuis 2008, Erik Desmazières s’est tourné ces dernières années vers des paysages réalistes.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Eugene Delacroix.You will discover his labour with The barque of Dante, Portrait of Aspasie, The assassination of the bishop of liege.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Edgar Degas.You will discover his labour with Portrait of hilaire rené Degas, race horses, ballet rehearsal on the set.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Hopper’s work is the most recognisable art in America – popular, praised, and mysterious. Countless painters, photographers, filmmakers and musicians have been influenced by his art – but who was he, and how did a struggling illustrator create such a bounty of notable work?This new film takes a deep look into Hopper’s art, his life, and his relationships. From his early career as an illustrator; his wife giving up her own promising art career to be his manager; his critical and commercial acclaim; and in his own words – this film explores the enigmatic personality behind the brush….

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Créé à la fin du XIXe siècle par le collectionneur Richard Wallace, ce musée privé de Londres conserve une très belle collection de peintures européennes. On peut entre autres y admirer Le cavalier riant de Frans Hals ou le Portrait de Titus, le fils de Rembrandt. La peinture française du XVIIIe siècle dans sa veine galante et rococo y est particulièrement bien représentée avec, bien sûr, le chef-d’œuvre de la peinture libertine de Fragonard, Les hasards heureux de l’escarpolette.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Serpent, cétacé, veine saillante, rivière. Vue du ciel, la structure qui sillonne Médiacité, le nouveau grand complexe commercial de Liège ressemble à un vitrail géant. Cette étonnante artère qui se gonfle, se courbe et sinue sur plus de 350 mètres de long est une rue couverte, la galerie principale d’un immense centre commercial construit en 2009 pour revitaliser un ancien quartier industriel en déshérence. Conçue par un chaloupeur de formes, le designer israélien Ron Arad, chantre de l’expérimentation et de la provocation, connu dans le monde entier pour ses meubles ludiques aux formes arrondies et sculpturales, il change ici d’échelle pour se lancer à la conquête de l’architecture et renouveler une typologie, souvent décriée, l’architecture commerciale.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: John Singer Sargent: Fashion and Swagger
programme.desc: John Singer Sargent is known as the greatest portrait artist of his era. What made his ‘swagger’ portraits remarkable was his power over his sitters, what they wore and how they were presented to the audience. Through interviews with curators, contemporary fashionistas and style influencers, Exhibition on Screen’s film will examine how Sargent’s unique practice has influenced modern art, culture and fashion.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Narrated by Gillian Anderson, this episode of Exhibition on Screen follows the footsteps of French artists such as Renoir and Monet, the American Impressionist movement forged its own path. Painted over a period of 40 years, these paintings reveal the United States both as a nation and as a creative breeding ground. The history of this movement is closely linked to the love of gardens and the desire to preserve nature in a country undergoing rapid urbanization. This enchanting journey through workshops, gardens and famous sites in the USA, UK and France is a feast for the eyes.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Qui était Frida Kahlo ? Voyagez dans la vie d'une véritable icône, découvrez son art et la vérité qui se cache derrière sa vie souvent mouvementée. La combinaison d'interviews, de commentaires et d'une exploration détaillée de l'art de Kahlo, offre un trésor de couleurs et un festin de vitalité. Ce documentaire personnel et intime offre un accès privilégié à ses œuvres, et met en lumière sa créativité fébrile, sa résilience et sa soif inégalée pour la vie.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Francisco de Goya (1746-1828) est un peintre et graveur espagnol. Il introduit plusieurs ruptures stylistiques qui initièrent le romantisme et annoncèrent le début de la peinture contemporaine. Ses œuvres incluent des peintures de chevalet, des peintures murales, des gravures et des dessins. Nous allons découvrir des œuvres telles que “Self-portrait with glasses”, “The sleep of reason produces monsters” ou encore “The young ones”.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Aujourd’hui, on relève le piquant avec les gastronomes gourmets Tony Singh et Cyrus Todiwala. Les chefs sont accompagnés de David Harper et Natasha Raskin.Partant de Dundee, ils descendent la côte est de l’Écosse jusqu’au village de Rosewell, dans le Midlothian, pour une vente aux enchères. Cyrus démontre un talent certain pour négocier, tandis que Tony n’hésite pas à afficher ses prix.Tony découvre pourquoi une ville écossaise a été le foyer de nombreux millionnaires, et Cyrus prend ses marques en mer en apprenant pourquoi Anstruther était un port de pêche clé au XIXe siècle.

programme.title: Van Gogh: The Real Story
programme.desc: In many ways, it is in Antwerp that Vincent begins the remarkable evolution that will ultimately make him one of the most important painters in modern art.

programme.title: Van Gogh: The Real Story
programme.desc: Perhaps the most well-known fact about Vincent's troubled life is that he cuts his ear. Dive into the horrifying story of what it is that inspires him to do something so drastic.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The Impressionists are the most popular group in art history - millions flock every year to marvel at their masterpieces. But, to begin with, they were scorned, penniless outsiders. 1874 was the year that changed everything; the first Impressionists, “hungry for independence”, broke the mould by holding their own exhibition outside official channels. Impressionism was born and the art world was changed forever.What led to that first groundbreaking show 150 years ago? Who were the maverick personalities that wielded their brushes in such a radical and provocative way? The spectacular Musée d’Orsay exhibition brings fresh eyes to this extraordinary tale of passion and rebellion. The story is told not by historians and curators but in the words of those who witnessed the dawn of Impressionism: the artists, press and people of Paris, 1874. See the show that changed everything on the big screen.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Pablo Picasso est l’un des plus grands artistes au monde, et jusqu’à sa mort en 1973, il était le plus prolifique. Comment tout a commencé ? Comment s’est construit Picasso ? Après avoir été trop longtemps ignorées, il est temps de se concentrer sur les jeunes années de l’artiste et son éducation qui lui ont permis d’accomplir l’extraordinaire. Trois villes ont joué un rôle-clé : Malaga, Barcelone et Paris. "Le jeune Picasso" les traverse et explore leur influence sur l’artiste, en analysant des œuvres spécifiques de ses débuts.

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet Edouard Elias, photographer. He spent part of his childhood in Egypt, then he was raised by his grandparents who taught him a lot about History. Very young he was already immersed in History and especially in pictorial History because he watched a lot of magazines and reports on television.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Lynne Faulds Wood and John Stapleton
programme.desc: Un Road Trip en couple de célébrités – les journalistes primés John Stapleton et Lynn Faulds Wood.Ils sont rejoints par Thomas Plant et Margie Cooper pour cette aventure. Avec 400 £ chacun, les équipes commencent à Wrightington, dans le Lancashire, et se dirigent vers Stockport pour une vente aux enchères.Lynn et Thomas se retrouvent littéralement jusqu'aux genoux dans des antiquités en cherchant de vieilles boîtes à biscuits, tandis que Margie tente de convaincre John que des lampes rares feront un joli profit.John apprend comment un Américain a révolutionné les transports publics britanniques, et Lynn découvre pourquoi on traite du lait de serpent à Liverpool.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Actor and charmer Nigel Havers and his canny, deal-making chum (and ex-agent) Michael Whitehall explore the West Country. Travelling by Bentley and TVR, they’ll have £400 each and expert advice from Margie Cooper and James Braxton. But what will do best at the auction... Nigel’s old cockle bucket or Michael’s tambourine? Plus there’s a trip to see some Bristol Savages and bit of Georgian elegance with the story of ‘The King of Bath’.

programme.title: Masterpiece
programme.desc: Rembrandt van Rijn a réalisé ce tableau à l'âge de 24 ans. Il s'agit d'un tableau incroyablement complexe dans lequel tout son talent est réuni : L'effet enchanteur entre l'esquisse et le petit détail. Mais aussi l'expression de tous les différents matériaux tels que le velours, le métal, le corail rouge et la roche. Michel van de Laar, membre de l'équipe, a restauré des œuvres de Rembrandt dans le passé et a découvert que la peinture cachait quelque chose de spécial : Un cheveu de Rembrandt. Lors de la reconstruction, un cheveu sera également remis en place. Et pas n'importe quel cheveu : une recherche passionnante mène à un descendant de Rembrandt.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.sub-title: Piero Della Francesca, The Montefeltro Altarpiece
programme.desc: For us today the Montefeltro Altarpiece, preserved in the Brera Art Gallery in Milan, is the “Altarpiece by Piero” par excellence. It is surprising to learn however, that until the late 1800s no one would ever have dreamed of attributing this impressive masterpiece to the hand of Piero della Francesca. For long centuries it was a deeply-rooted belief that the painter of the work was a certain Bartolomeo Corradini, a friar-painter known by the funny nickname of Fra Carnevale. It is in this guise that the Montefeltro Altarpiece came to Brera in 1811 and all the catalogues of the Milan Art Gallery repeated Fra Carnevale’s name until the end of that century. Piero della Francesca was simply forgotten... His name and his works ended up literally in the dust of oblivion until they disappeared from the horizon of history... His critical resurrection happened however, in the early 1900s, the century in which the Master painter wielded a powerful influence on the art of the first decades….

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.desc: The image of the wealthy merchant from Lucca Giovanni Arnolfini shown together with his wife in the intimacy of their comfortable home in Bruges has always been considered the brilliant figurative proof of the commercial and artistic relations between Italy and Flanders in the 15th century. However, there has been a certain amount of doubtful attention devoted to the figures for some time; in fact, the hypothesis that one of the maximum masterpieces of portraiture of all times may not depict the Arnolfinis at all, but the van Eycks, is not entirely new. It had already been cautiously suggested by the Director of London’s National Gallery over a century and a half ago, when the painting was purchased by the great museum, but the idea was soon cast aside by the objections of specialists. Other doubts about the couple’s identity have cropped up a number of times, juggled back and forth amongst the abundant historic information on the painting, archival research, and allegorical theori.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Vermeer and music - the art of love and leisure
programme.desc: La National Gallery de Londres propose un nouveau regard sur l'un des plus grands artistes de tous les temps, Johannes Vermeer. Il est le peintre de la célèbre toile “La Jeune Fille à la perle”. Dans une exposition intitulée "Vermeer et la musique : L'art de l'amour et des loisirs

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: An emblematic figure in Europe at the turn of the 18th century, this corporal who became Emperor of France unleashed the imagination of artists from whom he commissioned many works. Discover the victorious young “Bonaparte at the Pont d’Arcole” immortalised by the Antoine-Jean Gros in 1796. Observe also the portraits of all the guests present during the “Coronation of Napoleon” and his triumphant gesture as he crowned his wife Josephine in David’s masterpiece displayed in the Louvre Museum. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Jean Prouvé dreamed of creating homes as beautiful and rational as airplanes or automobiles. In 1953, at a time when he was going through the worst crisis of his life, he built his own house. Created in a hurry, out of bricks and mortar, it embodied his most innovative ideas. In a France where concrete was king, Prouvé was a man of metal, first folded sheet metal, then aluminum. From the 1930s onwards, he tried to rationalize the design of his buildings, dreaming of a housing industry that would build houses with the same precision with which cars and planes are built. This is what he calls "putting architecture back where it belongs". He is designing several models of low-cost, do-it-yourself kit homes, ready for mass production. Intelligent, functional and necessarily beautiful. The house he built for himself and his family in the heights of Nancy in the space of a few weeks in the summer of 1953, under dramatic circumstances, is a particularly moving embodiment of the designs and.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: François Boucq draws from morning to night in his studio, alone, as if he wanted to be more closely involved with his characters, moving from the savagery of the American West to the diplomacy of the Vatican, from the urban jungle to the news of the daily press. He has been drawing for 40 years with realism, with a precise and detailed line, a graphic finesse that makes him one of the undisputed masters of today's comics.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Netherland painter, Vincent van Gogh.You will discover his labour with Self-portrait, Memory of the garden at Etten, Van Gogh’s chair.

programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Russian painter, Vassily Kandinsky. You will discover his labour with Old city n°2, Park of Saint-cloud, Rider (improvisation n°12).

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Caspar David Friedrich (1774-1840) est un peintre romantique allemand qui s’est surtout concentré sur l’art du paysage, qu’il traite avec une touche minutieuse. Il a été redécouvert à la fin du XIXe s. De caractère mélancolique, il a peuplé ses toiles de figures humaines de dos, contemplant l’immensité de la nature, comme son très célèbre Voyageur au-dessus de la mer de nuages de Hambourg ou ses Falaises de craie à Rügen. Observez ses superbes paysages aux tons crépusculaires.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: It's a school like no other, built entirely of bamboo on the island of Bali in Indonesia. An ambitious project launched by American expatriates John and Cynthia Hardy. Together with a team of architects and artists, they decided in 2006 to build a school where everything had to be invented: a pedagogy, an ecological economic model that would protect the planet, and a new architecture built from a single material. A triple challenge.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The National Gallery in London is one of the world’s greatest art galleries. It is brimming with masterpieces, an inexhaustible treasure trove of history and an endless source of stories. This film gives a voice to those whose lives have been touched by the Gallery, from the security guard to the director, including daily visitors, celebrities and members of the royal family. Claudia Winkleman, Michael Palin, Terry Gilliam, Jacqueline Wilson and Her Royal Highness Princess Eugenie reveal their deeply personal connection to the National Gallery.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Canaletto and the Art of Venice
programme.desc: Canaletto et l’art de Venise, un voyage en immersion dans la vie et l’art du célèbre peintre de Venise. Aucun artiste n’a su mieux capturer l’essence et le charme de cette ville que Giovanni Antonio Canal, plus connu sous le nom de Canaletto. La remarquable collection regroupe plus de 200 tableaux, dessins et eaux-fortes nous permet de partir à la découverte du talent artistique de Canaletto, de ses contemporains et de la ville qu’il a su reproduire avec génie. Le film ouvre également les portes de deux résidences royales officielles, Buckingham Palace et le château de Windsor, pour nous en apprendre plus sur l’artiste et sur Joseph Smith, l’homme qui a fait découvrir Canaletto à la Grande-Bretagne.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Le collectionneur danois : de Delacroix à Gauguin
programme.desc: Wilhelm Hansen fut un homme d’affaires visionnaire, qui vécut au Danemark au XIXème siècle. Il fut l’un des rares collectionneurs à s’intéresser aux peintres impressionnistes, à une époque où ils étaient attaqués et dénigrés. Le film nous amène dans la maison d’été de Hansen dans la banlieue de Copenhague et nous fait visiter l’extraordinaire exposition à la Royal Academy de Londres consacrée à sa collection.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Antonio Canal, known as Canaletto, and Francesco Guardi are the best known 18th century painters of the urban Venetian landscape. In minute detail, they painted iconic views of the Venetian Republic, destined for rich foreign visitors. “Maria della Salute from the Grand Canal in Venice” by Canaletto and “Venice: Piazza San Marco” by Guardi followed this trend. Later Venice also inspired Paul Signac’s “The Green Veil, Venice”. Go on a voyage of discovery...Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Jean-François Millet (1814 - 1875) was a 19th-century French realist painter, pastellist, engraver and draughtsman. He is best known for his realistic rural scenes.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.sub-title: Tanni Grey Thompson and Jade Jones
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, nous sommes dans le Nord-Est de l'Angleterre avec les grandes paralympiennes en fauteuil roulant Tanni Grey-Thompson et Jade Jones. Tanni, avec son impressionnant palmarès de médailles et de records, est accompagnée de sa jeune protégée Jade, qui débute sa carrière en athlétisme.Avec les experts Phil Serrell et David Harper, la baronne du comté de Durham et Jade, de Middlesbrough, partiront à la recherche d'antiquités à vendre lors d'une vente aux enchères à Harrogate.Tanni tente également sa chance dans la fabrication traditionnelle du verre, tandis que Jade découvre l'histoire de l'homme qui fut un pionnier du design dans la région.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.desc: The image of the wealthy merchant from Lucca Giovanni Arnolfini shown together with his wife in the intimacy of their comfortable home in Bruges has always been considered the brilliant figurative proof of the commercial and artistic relations between Italy and Flanders in the 15th century. However, there has been a certain amount of doubtful attention devoted to the figures for some time; in fact, the hypothesis that one of the maximum masterpieces of portraiture of all times may not depict the Arnolfinis at all, but the van Eycks, is not entirely new. It had already been cautiously suggested by the Director of London’s National Gallery over a century and a half ago, when the painting was purchased by the great museum, but the idea was soon cast aside by the objections of specialists. Other doubts about the couple’s identity have cropped up a number of times, juggled back and forth amongst the abundant historic information on the painting, archival research, and allegorical theori.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.sub-title: Piero Della Francesca, The Montefeltro Altarpiece
programme.desc: For us today the Montefeltro Altarpiece, preserved in the Brera Art Gallery in Milan, is the “Altarpiece by Piero” par excellence. It is surprising to learn however, that until the late 1800s no one would ever have dreamed of attributing this impressive masterpiece to the hand of Piero della Francesca. For long centuries it was a deeply-rooted belief that the painter of the work was a certain Bartolomeo Corradini, a friar-painter known by the funny nickname of Fra Carnevale. It is in this guise that the Montefeltro Altarpiece came to Brera in 1811 and all the catalogues of the Milan Art Gallery repeated Fra Carnevale’s name until the end of that century. Piero della Francesca was simply forgotten... His name and his works ended up literally in the dust of oblivion until they disappeared from the horizon of history... His critical resurrection happened however, in the early 1900s, the century in which the Master painter wielded a powerful influence on the art of the first decades….

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les actrices et amies de Casualty, Susan Cookson et Suzanne Packer, troquent leurs blouses de chirurgie contre une Sunbeam Tiger de 1965 pour se lancer dans une compétition à travers le Nord-Ouest de l’Angleterre, accompagnées des experts James Braxton et David Harper.Susan découvre son côté négociatrice, tandis que Suzanne garde un œil très vigilant sur le budget, cherchant à trouver un objet vraiment ancien.Au fil du voyage à travers le Yorkshire, elles ont l'opportunité de rencontrer une femme très spéciale de Sheffield et de visiter des jardins incroyables avec une histoire fascinante.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Cette exposition très attendue à la Royal Academy of Arts était la toute première rétrospective consacrée au portrait d'Édouard Manet. Couvrant l'ensemble de la carrière de cet artiste énigmatique et parfois controversé, l'exposition a rassemblé des œuvres provenant d'Europe, d'Asie et des États-Unis. Le portrait de Manet n'a jamais fait l'objet d'une exposition, bien qu'il représente environ la moitié de sa production artistique. Il a peint sa famille, ses amis et les personnalités littéraires, politiques et artistiques de l'époque, donnant vie non seulement à ses sujets mais aussi à la société parisienne.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: « J’envie les Japonais », écrivait Van Gogh à son frère, Théo. Grâce à l’exposition sur laquelle est basé ce film, « Van Gogh et le Japon », au musée Van Gogh d’Amsterdam, on comprend pourquoi. Bien que Vincent van Gogh n’ait jamais visité le Japon, il reste le pays qui a eu le plus d’influence sur lui et son œuvre. En se rendant dans les galeries d’art japonais à Paris et en créant sa propre image du Japon après des recherches approfondies, des collections d’estampes et de longues discussions avec d’autres artistes, la découverte des œuvres japonaises entraîna la carrière de Van Gogh dans une nouvelle direction très excitante.

programme.desc: In this episode, we will discuss with Philippe Barbosa, reportage and corporate photographer. The term corporate photography means that he works for companies and produces images for them. It can be to make portraits of executives, for events... Paired with experts David Harper and Catherine Southon they Road Trip from Bletchley in Buckinghamshire to an auction in London. There’s also opportunity to hear how Mrs Beeton became the first ‘domestic Goddess’ and why Luton played a critical role in the fashion world when hats were de rigueur daily wear. David and Suzannah gamble on a giant ant while Catherine and Kate plump for a very large tea urn.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les chefs télévisés Aldo Zilli et Ching He-Huang s’affrontent lors de ce Road Trip à travers le sud-est de l’Angleterre, accompagnés des experts Natasha Raskin et Paul Laidlaw.Aldo mise sur une bague en or malgré les conseils des experts, tandis que Ching espère que des antiquités d’origine orientale feront un beau score aux enchères dans le nord de Londres.En chemin, Aldo fait une halte pour rencontrer Jill, une doyenne de 200 ans qui fournissait autrefois la population en farine. De son côté, l’amoureuse des animaux Ching découvre l’histoire d’un homme qui, au XIXe siècle, a risqué le ridicule et la ruine pour protéger le bétail.

programme.title: Masterpiece
programme.desc: Monet est le fondateur de l'impressionnisme, une forme d'art qui met l'accent sur l'expérience de l'instant, la vie moderne et la peinture en plein air. Ce tableau, réalisé lors d'un de ses nombreux séjours aux Pays-Bas, est un élément important de sa quête impressionniste. Charlotte, comme Monet, se rend sur les canaux pour peindre. L'équipe visite l'ancienne maison et l'atelier de Monet à Giverny, en France, et revient avec du matériel utile pour la reconstitution.

De son côté, Nancy, mannequin et présentatrice télé, sait aussi marchander et elle est très compétitive ! Le couple est accompagné par les experts Charlie Ross et Thomas Plant.Soyez attentif au don surprenant de Jim pour deviner l’âge de presque tout, à Dixon traversant les chutes du Niagara et à une leçon de navigation par longitude.Et surtout, la mystérieuse Mme Parker fera-t-elle son apparition à la vente aux enchères ?

programme.desc: Pour ce quatrième jour de compétition, c'est Monica, la jolie Parisienne, qui entre en scène. Mais derrière ses airs de citadine, à 52 ans, elle est une adversaire redoutable, avec de nombreux atouts en poche. La décoration, c'est une véritable passion pour notre doyenne de la semaine.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes you through the Pyrénées Orientales, then Corsica, before making a stop on the Côte d'Azur, and concludes her journey between Rungis and Paris... all to explore the world of citrus fruits! These fruits add flavor, zest, and seasoning to any recipe, making them indispensable in the kitchen. They bring the warmth and sunshine of the South of France and the exoticism of distant lands. While we're all familiar with lemons, clementines, and grapefruits, Julie introduces us to a thousand other varieties.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes you on a bread trail to uncover the dedicated artisan bakers and millers. Her adventure will lead her through the Libourne region, then onwards to the North of France, the Ardèche, and the Aisne, where bakers have transformed bread into a powerful catalyst for social cohesion. While some individuals may avoid bread, particularly due to gluten-related concerns, others have chosen to reposition it at the forefront of the dining experience by championing its nutritional benefits. This commitment is shared by several chefs whom Julie will meet at the conclusion of her expedition.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C'est à Giverny que démarre le voyage de Julie, celui dont le nom résonne immédiatement comme le berceau de l’Impressionnisme a gardé une authenticité émouvante, Giverny impose son style, murmure son histoire. Sa notoriété est fortement liée à la présence historique de Claude Monet et à tous les fabuleux témoins laissés par ce dernier. Claude Monet a aussi laissé son empreinte dans la cuisine à Giverny. Ses carnets de recettes sont là pour en témoigner. C’est dans ces carnets que Julie va s’inspirer pour remplir le sien, au menu : Lapin en compote, feuilleté d’andouilles au camembert, et charlottes aux abricots.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Cap au Nord pour découvrir une ville française absolument incontournable : Lille. Cette ville possède un patrimoine architectural exceptionnel, marchande dès le Moyen Age, citadelle sous Louis XIV, industrielle au XIXe...elle s'agrandit au cours des siècles. Julie ira à la rencontre de ceux qui participent à la renommée de la ville et de la région, et à travers son patrimoine culinaire avec au menu de ce voyage : la recette du coq à la bière, celle du hochepot, et sur une note sucrée, une crème brûlée à la chicorée. .

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Si l’été est la saison où les légumes abondent au potager, il serait dommage de ne pas savourer ceux que les saisons plus fraîches nous offrent : potages, tourtes, potées ou gratins mettent à l’honneur des légumes de saisons, idéals pour se réchauffer. Pour débuter ce nouveau voyage, un légume qui trônait déjà sur les tables de la Grèce Antique : le salsifis que Julie cuisinera avec une drôle de tourtière…L’hiver c’est aussi la saison du chou alors direction la Champagne pour y apprendre la recette de la potée locale qui devrait remplir le ventre d’un grand nombre de convives.Ce petit tour de France nous emmènera aussi à la découverte d’orfèvres du maraîchage qui sculptent légumes et fruits d’hiver, et vous présentera différentes techniques et méthodes pour sublimer vos potagers.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: A good breakfast is a healthy, balanced meal made up of 5 energy-giving elements: protein, fiber, carbohydrates, healthy fats and hydration. Luana Belmondo offers us a healthy breakfast that will satisfy both salty and sweet palates: oatmeal, avocado and salmon, buddha bowl with chia seeds and seasonal fruit, and vegan panacakes.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo and her Italian friend Alessandra Pierini are preparing a pasta party. They'll be cooking pesto and sharing their tips on how to get it right. They'll also be making pasta saporita, full of color and flavor!

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Yann Arthus-Bertrand thus continues his world tour and his inventory of the planet with the great rivers that suffer from man's excesses as a common thread. " So the great rivers may live" is the discovery of places, men and women who are fighting so that our waterways simply have their place on Earth. Thanks to his genius, man is correcting his mistakes: the Aral Sea, which once disappeared, is coming back. In New York, millions of people have drinking water thanks to the natural virtues of the forest.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Les Héros de la Nature : Bangladesh - Partie 2
programme.desc: With Bangladesh as a running thread, Yann Arthus-Bertrand meets several people who have changed their lives to dedicate themselves to a major project. In Bangladesh, Yves and Runa Marre have created the Friendship Foundation. Among other things, they’ve created a floating hospital installed on an old barge bought in France. Julie Andersen, an ex-advertising executive from New York, has come to South Africa to defend sharks with her Shark Angels Foundation. In North India, Kartik Satyanarayan is helping to stop the dreadful exploitation of the lippus bears (dancing bears). He’s created Wildlife SOS, a preserve to rehabilitate the bears that have been rescued and to give work to the men of the tribe who were traditionally bear tamers and entertainers.

programme.sub-title: Defending water is defending life - Part 1
programme.desc: Les océans recouvrent plus de 70 % de la surface de la Terre. La mer est le plus vaste environnement naturel de notre planète et demeure quasiment inexploitée. En Bretagne, dans les Sept Îles. Puis dans la baie de Saint-Brieuc, au milieu d’une mer d’algues vertes. En Bretagne, l’agriculture intensive s’est développée depuis une trentaine d’années. En Nouvelle-Calédonie, la barrière de corail est la deuxième plus grande barrière corallienne du monde qui pourrait être menacée par la construction d’une mine de nickel. En Normandie, dans le Jardin botanique de Vauville, un jardin extraordinaire compte des plantes du monde entier. Également dans l’Archipel de Chausey en Normandie avec les plus hautes marées d’Europe. Ou encore le Mont Saint Michel. Victime de l’ensablement et des travaux réalisés par l’homme, le Mont n’était plus une île. En Italie, à Venise, au bord de la noyade, les grands travaux d’aménagement, l’industrialisation et le tourisme ont bouleversé le milieu. En Nouvelle Calé.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: On se retrouve au parc National du Yellowstone aux Etats-Unis, il est situé dans le premier parc naturel créé au monde. Au Pérou, la forêt amazonienne est victime d’un déboisement massif. Le désert aux portes de Pékin est régulièrement touché par des tempêtes de sable. Certains experts prédisent que la capitale chinoise pourrait être menacée par les déserts d’ici cent ans. Dans le Montana, la productivité agricole américaine a un coût écologique et humain. L’ingénieur Marc Dufumier explique comment la mécanisation fragilise les équilibres naturels. Au Brésil les agrocarburants ont permis de réduire la dépendance au pétrole, de diminuer la pollution atmosphérique des villes et même de limiter les émissions de gaz à effet de serre. À Los Angeles, les activités humaines ont perturbé le fonctionnement de l’effet de serre et l’ont accentué. Aujourd’hui, la Terre chauffe.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie reprend la route à bord de sa petite voiture rouge pour faire honneur à l’un de ses fruits favoris : la châtaigne. Julie ira à la rencontre de plusieurs producteurs en Ardèche, cuisinera la soupe traditionnelle de la région aux côtés de la pétillante Marithé. Elle fera aussi la recette des marrons glacés maison, avant de filer en Corse pour travailler la farine de châtaignes et les feuilles de son arbre. Ce périple s’achèvera comme toujours avec une recette de chef astucieuse et cette-fois ce sera Claude Brioude qui s’y collera ! Ce chef aime bousculer les codes et travaillera la châtaigne avec le poisson, deux produits de saison que l’on n’a pas forcément l’habitude de marier.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie nous emmène en Bretagne sud et plus précisément dans le quartier maritime du Guilvinec pour faire avec vous la route du poisson depuis les filets jusqu’à vos assiettes. Le Guilvinec a beau être le premier port de pêche artisanale français, tous les bords de mers de l’hexagone réservent de bons produits de saison. Julie remonte donc en voiture pour découvrir dans le sud un certain nombre de poissons d’élevage dans une ferme aquacole en Méditerranée, tout en cuisinant le bar à Noirmoutier, la lotte dans le Nord et même le cabillaud dans l’immense marché de Rungis. Julie a challengé le Chef Olivier Bellin installé à Plomodiern dans le Finistère, pour qu’il cuisine un poisson méconnu : la vieille.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana cuisine avec l'interprète du titre phare de La Reine des Neiges : Anaïs Delva. Ensemble, elles vont préparer deux recettes 100% végétariennes, philosophie adoptée par la chanteuse. Au menu : fettucini de courgettes grillées, haricots blancs au pesto et burger végétarien. Comme quoi, il est possible de se régaler avec des plats végétariens sans rester sur sa faim !

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, Luana Belmondo cuisine un poisson de la Méditerranée, le rouget. Au menu : filets de rouget avec de la purée d'avocat et des carottes au cumin, et mille-feuille de rouget avec des légumes printaniers.

programme.title: The Great Gardening Challenge
programme.desc: This week it’s the last of the heats and sees a pair of new kids on the block taking on a more experienced and established pair of garden designers. For Millie Souter from London and Max Parker-Smith from Surrey it’s a huge challenge as both of them have only recently graduated in garden design from the prestigious Inchbald Garden Design College so have limited experience of actually creating gardens. Making things even tougher, it’s also the first time the friends have worked together. Opposing them is Nicola Bailey Gibson and Viv Seccombe who bring years of experience designing and building private gardens and award-winning show gardens. The challenge our pairs face is to create amazing gardens for Focus Birmingham Day Care Centre which offers activities and support to people with severe visual and physical disabilities. And they have to do this is just 2 days and on a budget of £5000.

programme.title: The Wonderful World of Crafting
programme.desc: Three hobby crafters present their works for the first time at Brancepeth Castle Craft Fair in Durham. Occupational therapist Olivia dyes her own yarn and produces hand-woven pieces, ex-builder Neil makes quirky metal ornaments and Wendi now makes her own glass pieces uses the art of fusing - and for the fair she even learns the art of glass blowing.

programme.title: The Great Gardening Challenge
programme.desc: This week’s heat sees professional teams from opposite ends of the UK compete as they’re challenged to create amazing spaces in just 2 days on a budget of £5000, for the Care for Veterans’ care home in Worthing, a specialist care home for elderly and disabled military veterans. Experienced garden designers and builders, James Hutchison and Stuart Gibson have travelled to the South Coast all the way from London. While their opponents, Manoj Maldé and Mark Holman, garden designers who collaborate on show gardens together, have only had to travel from Hertfordshire and Kent. With a brief that includes making sure the gardens are wheelchair friendly and low maintenance the teams come up with very different designs. James and Stuart are faced with a potentially disastrous problem they aren’t used to dealing with back in Scotland. But can they resolve it in time and finish their garden?

programme.title: The Wonderful World of Crafting
programme.desc: Four passionate hobby crafters showcase their talents at the Crafty Vintage Fair at Lowther Castle in Penrith, Cumbria. From intricate needle-felt creations to imaginative plastic sculptures and beautifully crafted wooden furniture, each maker strives to turn their passion into success. This episode captures their creative journeys, the challenges they face, and the thrill of presenting their work at a prestigious fair. Will their crafts capture the hearts of visitors and lead to life-changing opportunities?

programme.title: The Great Gardening Challenge
programme.desc: In this week’s episode, professional garden design partners Jon Smith and Adam Woolcott take on Catherine and James Burrage from Yorkshire. Their challenge is to deliver amazing garden spaces on a budget of £5000 for the Knightswood Day Care Centre in the heart of the Essex countryside within sniffing distance of the North Sea. The centre offers a lifeline to mainly elderly local people who have physical or mental disabilities or who live alone. With a brief from the centre that includes sensory elements, seating and a potting shed, both teams have ambitious designs but can they complete them in just 2 days?

Faites rayonner la lumière de votre cœur en apprenant à respirer avec ampleur. Cette pratique encourage une action guidée par des intentions d’amour, de pardon et de gratitude.

programme.title: Home training
programme.desc: This episode of "Home Training" is dedicated to a full-body workout. Guillaume and Sabrina target the entire body, focusing on strengthening both deep and superficial muscles. The session is progressive, with intensity adjustments in each set to maintain effort throughout the training. Torso twists are included to activate the spine and engage more muscle groups. This varied and dynamic program promises effective overall strengthening, with modifications tailored to each level.

programme.sub-title: Strong, Slow and Steady: Hand Balancing and Hip Opening
programme.desc: Arrive at your practice, prepared to be where you are. Strong, Slow and Steady moves you through that everchallenging Crow Pose, while guiding you to the realization that you cannot fail to be where you already are. Leave your conception perfect behind as you explore this awakening sequence.

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: L'heure du verdict est enfin arrivée. Les quatre chantiers sont terminés et les candidats vont faire face aux critiques de leurs adversaires. Mais surtout, les propriétaires vont rentrer chez eux et découvrir leur pièce entièrement redécorée. Que penseront-ils de leur nouvel intérieur ? Quelles notes vont-ils attribuer ? Ultime espoir pour tenter de remporter la compétition : être le coup de cœur de Valérie Damidot, notre experte, et obtenir son point bonus. Qui repartira avec les 2000 € et le titre d’As de la déco de la semaine ?

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: If you're a nature enthusiast and a fan of outdoor cooking, the upcoming season is perfect for barbecue enthusiasts! Our journey will take us to Aube, nestled in the heart of the Brévonnes forest, and then to the Massif des Bauges, where grilling and snow create a unique combination. Afterward, we'll explore the Libournais region, where we'll uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area. Just a short distance from the vineyards, we'll arrive at another corner of Gironde, the Blaye region, where the cooking method remains consistent but features a distinctly local ingredient: eel.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us down a different kind of yellow-brick road, one that tastes of childhood and gourmet delights: the road of sweets. France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: It is in the heart of the Sarthe that Julie begins her new tour. Located in the Pays de la Loire region, the Sarthe department is the gateway to the French Grand Ouest. In the Haut Maine region, Le Mans is a city of art as well as a historic city, which played a decisive role in the development of the automobile. The country of Le Mans is distinguished by the diversity of its heritage, having kept in its stones the imprints of all eras. This region is notably renowned for its poulet de Loué, its capon and many other regional specialities. Let's go for a real Sarthe gourmet journey, with veal rouelles à la mancelle, roast poularde and seasonal fruit tart.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie nous donne rendez-vous à Bordeaux après avoir arpenté le pays de Blaye, visité deux fois le bassin et parcouru les terres du Libournais à deux reprises, il fallait bien s’arrêter un jour dans la capitale du Bordelais ! N’y-a-t-il pas meilleure saison que le mois de septembre pour découvrir la perle d’Aquitaine, plus souvent appelée « Cité du vin » ? Julie donne rendez-vous à ces habitants pour découvrir les traditions mais aussi les projets plus récents de cette ville chargée d’Histoire et de gastronomie.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Aujourd’hui, les plus gourmands ne devraient pas être déçus puisque c’est le chocolat qui est mis à l’honneur. Découvert par les mayas il y 2500 ans et plus largement ensuite par les Aztèques, le chocolat fait partie aujourd’hui des produits préférés des français. Et qu’on ne s’y trompe pas : au même titre que la cuisine a ses grands chef, le chocolat a aussi ses grands chocolatiers. Coté recettes, Julie fera découvrir un gâteau qu’on ne fait qu’à Saint Émilien et qui associe le chocolat au macaron, avant de rejoindre le Pays Basque pour un dessert qui ne manque pas de piment. Nous grimperons ensuite en montagne à la rencontre d’une cuisinière d’origine suisse qui fait des pains au chocolat à sa façon. Enfin, vous verrez que le chocolat nous réserve de nombreuses surprises : il possède de nombreuses vertus et s’utilise aussi pour le bien être.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo and her pastry chef friend Laurent Favre-Mot prepare desserts from our childhood. On the program: panettone in French toast, and torta della nonna with lemon cream and pine nuts, a typical Italian dessert!

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, nous allons voyager au Mexique avec les fajitas ! Un plat typique de la cuisine tex-mex. On va préparer ensemble des tortillas (galettes de maïs). Et pour la suite, des fajitas avec du poulet, des poivrons et des épices.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: The call of the Forest is about discovering places but above all it is about meeting those who protect this priceless heritage. Forests are essential to mankind. They capture CO2, promote the formation of clouds and therefore rain, protect the soil from erosion and provide a habitat for wildlife. From Madagascar, to France, to Cameroon, or even Eritrea, Yann Arthus-Bertrand sets out to discover the most beautiful forests, those who live in them, those who protect them and those who live off them.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Yann Arthus-Bertrand thus continues his world tour and his inventory of the planet with the great rivers that suffer from man's excesses as a common thread. " So the great rivers may live" is the discovery of places, men and women who are fighting so that our waterways simply have their place on Earth. Thanks to his genius, man is correcting his mistakes: the Aral Sea, which once disappeared, is coming back. In New York, millions of people have drinking water thanks to the natural virtues of the forest.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Les Héros de la Nature : Bangladesh - Partie 2
programme.desc: With Bangladesh as a running thread, Yann Arthus-Bertrand meets several people who have changed their lives to dedicate themselves to a major project. In Bangladesh, Yves and Runa Marre have created the Friendship Foundation. Among other things, they’ve created a floating hospital installed on an old barge bought in France. Julie Andersen, an ex-advertising executive from New York, has come to South Africa to defend sharks with her Shark Angels Foundation. In North India, Kartik Satyanarayan is helping to stop the dreadful exploitation of the lippus bears (dancing bears). He’s created Wildlife SOS, a preserve to rehabilitate the bears that have been rescued and to give work to the men of the tribe who were traditionally bear tamers and entertainers.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Les Héros de la Nature : Sénégal - Partie 1
programme.desc: For this new episode, Yann Arthus-Bertrand travels through Senegal to encounter men and women who dedicate their lives to preserving the environment. One of the major ecological stakes of the country is fishing and the mangrove ecosystem which, like in some many other parts of the world, faces major threats. Yann Arthus-Bertrand presents the struggle of Haidar El Ali, chosen among one of the world’s most active ecologists. He creates protected marine areas and reforests the disappeared mangrove of his country. He’s managed to convince thousands of Senegalese to plant with him ten million mangrove trees.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Defending water is defending life - Part 2
programme.desc: Les océans recouvrent plus de 70 % de la surface de la Terre. La mer est le plus vaste environnement naturel de notre planète et demeure quasiment inexploitée. En Corse, depuis une tour du Capo Rosso ainsi que dans les Calanques de Piana. Aux Galapagos, nous avons réalisé le portrait de Paul Watson, écologiste et co-fondateur de Greenpeace. Ce Canadien au physique de baroudeur a pris la défense des animaux marins. En Corse, dans les Bouches de Bonifacio, le bassin méditerranéen est l'un des plus riches en biodiversité de la planète avec comme objectif de préserver les côtes de l’urbanisation et protéger la vie marine. En Corse, avec la surpêche. Dans le monde, 75% des stocks de poissons sont menacés par la surexploitation. La cause ? La pêche à grande échelle, gaspilleuse et pas assez régulée. En Guinée-Bissau, les Bijagos, c’est un chapelet d’une centaine d’îles, dans ces eaux, le poisson abonde mais pour combien de temps encore ? En Corse, sur les Iles Sanguinaires, près de 50% des.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Direction le Loir-et-Cher pour une chasse à courre encadrée par les équipes de l’ONCFS. Prenons ensuite la route des Vosges pour cuisiner aux côtés de Mauricette une savoureuse gigue de cerf. Allons à la rencontre de Pierre en Côte d’Or où il fabrique des trompes de chasse, un outil indispensable à la vénerie. Julie retrouvera aussi deux chasseurs girondins pour une après-midi de chasse à la tonne dès plus originale avant de rejoindre Joël en Aquitaine pour une autre recette de gibier à plume. Nous parlerons ensuite avec Laurent du métier de piqueux : ce dresseur de chiens destinés à la vénerie. Cette fois-ci ce sera Frédéric Robert qui nous concoctera une recette de lièvre frotté au cacao et cuit dans un sarcophage d’argile.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie is offering you a trip to the south of France. Between the Rhone Valley and the Mediterranean, let's discover a fruit that is harvested in November: the olive.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, Luana Belmondo reçoit Delphine Malachard, qui est intolérante au gluten. Ensemble, elles vont donc cuisiner des recettes sans gluten. Au menu : soufflé au chocolat et financiers à la vanille et aux fruits rouges.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo cuisine la reine des protéines végétales : la lentille. Bonne pour la santé, digeste et délicieuse, elle remplace la viande et le poisson. Nous allons préparer des galettes de lentilles corail aux épices, avec une sauce au yaourt et à la menthe. Et pour la suite, un classique de la cuisine française : une salade de lentilles vertes avec de la saucisse de Morteau.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Do wild animals still exist ? - Part 1
programme.desc: Animals represent 2/3 of the species on earth. We are increasingly concerned about our impact on the world. But what place does man have for the wild animal? Discover how it is possible to reintroduce wild animals in South Africa, or the disaster that took place with the sea lions in Namibia, and also how to preserve rhinos or other animals in biodiversity. There, women and men manage to protect wildlife every day.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Do wild animals still exist ? - Part 2
programme.desc: Yann Arthus-Bertrand surprises us with preserved landscapes. And sometimes even with vast spaces where man's imprint remains invisible. Yann Arthus-Bertrand continues his world tour in favour of the protection of the environment and wildlife. From the tip of the African continent, he decides to take down the fences to let the animals roam freely, then he takes us to Cambodia to see if the tigers will disappear. Then we head to London to follow the chimpanzee or to France to study and save the bees.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: On se retrouve en Israël dans le désert du Neguev, Elaine cherche des solutions pour lutter contre la désertification. L’objet de ses recherches : les arbres, peu consommateurs d’eau. Au Mali, on retrouve les Dogons : les cultivateurs du désert. Il nous fait découvrir les recettes de son peuple pour gérer l’eau. Dans cette partie du Mali où il ne pleut quasiment jamais. En Palestine, le village de Wadi Fukeen. Un village où les agriculteurs utilisent un système d’irrigation et de partage de l’eau vieux de plus de 300 ans et basé sur le respect et la confiance. Et en Palestine à Gaza où les spécialistes se battent pour sauver des enfants palestiniens rendus malades par de l’eau impropre à la consommation. Dans la Vallée du Jourdain où trois pays en conflit affrontent les mêmes problèmes : le manque d’eau. Spekkhoggere bruker kun øyeblikk på å spise en grå hvalkalv før de drar kadaveret til havbunnen for å lagre kjøttet til magrere tider. Små kameraer festet på den døde hvalen filmet hele prosessen.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Ultralyd for en skjeggagam og sårbehandling for ei gås – listen over ting som må gjøres, tar aldri slutt. Dr. Lisa har to valpekriser på rad. Dr. Pol og dr. Brenda rykker ut sammen på gårdsbesøk, og dr. Nicole steller med en løskatt. Mens staben på klinikken tar seg av driften, eskorterer dr. Pol stolt veteraner til Washington, DC.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Dr. Pol opererer en hund, dr. Nicole undersøker en liten kattunge som har problemer med øyet og dr. Lisa hjelper en hest som sliter med brekninger. Etter å ha behandlet infeksjonen til en pomeranian og en pitbull med en mistenkelig kul, feirer dr. Pol og kona 55 års bryllupsdag.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Kio og brødrene hans har kommet til en ny og farlig verden. Som den yngste er Kio den mest sårbare. Da de oppdager et frodig våtmarksområde med rikelig med byttedyr og en løvinneflokk, virker det som det perfekte nye hjemmet. Men dette paradiset har allerede sine konger. Et brutalt angrep splitter brødreflokken og tvinger Kio på flukt. Alene og forlatt er sjansene hans for å overleve små, men han finner mot til å rope og gjenforenes med brødrene. Sammen møter de en rekke prøvelser, fra bøffeljakt til kamper med rivaler, og knytter et ubrytelig bånd. Til slutt, som en selvsikker og nesten fullvoksen hannløve, vender Kio tilbake for å utfordre de gamle kongene. Seier sikrer ham et kongerike, en flokk og en ny familie. Nederlag betyr eksil. Vil Kio falle, eller vil han reise seg og endelig innta tronen?

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Etter en desperat leting gjenforenes Kio og Summer med brødrene, men livet i utkanten av flokkens territorium er nådeløst. Summer sliter med å jakte for de uerfarne sønnene og forberede dem på et liv alene, og kampen for å overleve tærer på. Når et lett bytte blir for fristende, får det konsekvenser som forandrer Kios liv for alltid. Han tvinges til å bli selvstendig lenge før tiden, og nå må Kio og brødrene hans lære å overleve på egen hånd.
